import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np

adata = sc.read_h5ad('adata_filtered.h5ad')

# Save raw counts layer
adata.layers['counts'] = adata.X.copy()

# Normalize
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)

# HVG
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=2000, flavor='seurat')
print(adata.var['highly_variable'].sum())

adata.raw = adata  # store full log-norm data before subsetting

adata_hvg = adata[:, adata.var.highly_variable].copy()

sc.pp.scale(adata_hvg, max_value=10)
sc.tl.pca(adata_hvg, n_comps=50, svd_solver='arpack')

adata.obsm['X_pca'] = adata_hvg.obsm['X_pca']

adata.write('adata_norm.h5ad')
print("done")

import pandas as pd

adata = sc.read_h5ad('adata_clustered.h5ad')

adata.write('adata_final.h5ad')

import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd

adata = sc.read_h5ad('adata_final.h5ad')

cluster_to_celltype = {
    '0': 'CD4 T cell (naive/memory)',
    '1': 'CD8 T cell (cytotoxic/effector)',
    '2': 'CD14+ Monocyte',
    '3': 'B cell',
    '4': 'Proliferating lymphocyte',

    '8': 'Naive B cell',
    '9': 'NK cell',
    '10': 'Plasma cell',
    '11': 'Hematopoietic stem/progenitor cell (HSPC)',
    '12': 'Platelet',

    '14': 'CD8 T cell (memory, GZMK+)',
    '15': 'Conventional dendritic cell (cDC1)',
    '16': 'Regulatory T cell (Treg)',
    '17': 'Erythroid cell'
}
